jobs.title: Developer Placement
jobs.description:
**The role**

Technology drives what we do at NEXT, and as a Tech Placement, you will be a vital part of our evolution. This role is designed to help you learn and grow by giving you hands-on experience in full life-cycle development.

You will make a real difference by contributing to team objectives and helping to create and enhance new and existing systems. Working alongside and shadowing a supportive team of experienced Developers, Product Development Managers, Business Analysts, and Architects, you will receive the guidance you need to succeed.

**This is a 12-month industrial placement and applicants must be studying a relevant University Degree course that includes a dedicated placement year July 2027 to July 2028.**

**What you'll take on**

* Shadow our experienced Developers to learn about and participate in full life-cycle development.
  
* Help create and enhance applications using a wide variety of backend and front-end technologies, including C#, .NET, VUE.JS, HTML, and CSS.
  
* Write readable and maintainable code that fulfils user requirements to agreed quality standards.
  
* Collaborate closely within your team to troubleshoot, identify, and resolve bugs in the codebase.
  
* Implement, test, and deploy code changes following the company's development process.
  
* Participate actively in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and code reviews to discuss challenges and share your progress.
  
* Adapt to and utilise new AI technologies, such as CoPilot, Gemini, and Notebook LM, to streamline your ways of working and increase efficiencies.
  

**What you'll bring**

* Current study towards a STEM degree (on track for a 2:1 or higher) or a STEM Master's degree that includes a 12-month placement, ideally with relevant studies in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a similar field.
  
* We are looking for someone with a strong interest in how software works and a self-motivated desire to learn.
  
* You will bring a basic understanding of core languages like C#, VB.NET, VUE.JS, HTML, CSS, and Javascript, alongside the ability to adapt quickly to new technologies.
  
* Beyond your technical potential, you will need to be a great communicator who listens well, thinks in a structured manner, and collaborates effortlessly with others.
  

BE BRAVE. BE YOU. BE NEXT.

  

* 25% off most NEXT, MADE\*, Lipsy\*, Gap\* and Victoria's Secret\* products (\*when purchased through NEXT)
* Company performance based bonus
* Sharesave scheme
* On-site Nursery available; OFSTED outstanding in all areas
* 10% off most partner brands & up to 15% off Branded Beauty
* Early VIP access to sale stock
* Access to fantastic discounts at our Staff Shops
* Restaurants with great food at amazing prices
* Access a digital GP and other free health and wellbeing services
* Free on-site parking
* Financial Wellbeing - Save, track and enhance your financial wellbeing
* Apprenticeship - Grow and develop on the job whilst gaining a qualification
* Direct to Work - Discount online and instore, collect your items the next day for free from your place of work or local store
* Support Networks - Access to Network Groups to empower and celebrate each other
Wellhub - Discounted flexible monthly gym memberships, with apps, PT sessions and more

  

Conditions apply to all benefits. These benefits are discretionary and subject to change.

  

We aim to support all candidates during the application process and are happy to provide workplace adjustments when necessary. Should you need support with your application due to a disability or long-term condition, feel free to get in touch with us by email headoffice\_careers@next.co.uk (please include 'Workplace Adjustments' in the subject line), or call us on 0116 284 2486 and leave a voicemail.

  
You know Next, but did you know we’re a FTSE-100 retail company employing over 44,000 people across the Next group. We’re the UK’s 2nd largest fashion retailer and for Kidswear we’re the market leader. At the last count we have over 450 stores, plus the Next Online and it’s now possible to buy on-line from over 80 countries around the world! So we’ve gone global!

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Developer - TRATON Workshop Suite
jobs.description:
TRATON is a group of strong brands with a shared mission: transforming transportation together to create the future of sustainable transport solutions. Within TRATON, we include MAN, Scania, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International. As part of a global team of industry experts, you get to think bigger, experience more, and reach further. Together, we have the power to transform transportation - Let´s make a difference together. Find out more: www.traton.com

Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do.

**Role Summary**
----------------

*This role is part of TRATON Group R&D, located in Södertälje, Sweden.*

  

As a **Full-Stack Software Developer**, you will join Team Jaguar, one of several cross-functional development teams working together to build the **TRATON Workshop Suite (TWS)** – the digital workshop platform supporting technicians in servicing, maintaining and updating vehicles across the TRATON Group.

  

Team Jaguar is responsible for the **Software Update domain**, developing user-facing functionality that enables workshop technicians to safely and efficiently update vehicle software. The team owns the functionality and user experience end-to-end, from the workshop application through backend and cloud services. To deliver the complete solution, we collaborate closely with other TWS teams and use shared capabilities such as product and vehicle communication services.

  

In this role, you will work across the full technology stack, primarily using **C#/.NET, AWS and Angular** in a microservice-based architecture. The solutions you develop are ultimately used by workshop technicians in their daily work, giving the role a clear connection between the technology we build and the value it creates for our users.

  

You will be part of a team with shared responsibility for building, operating and continuously improving stable, secure and user-friendly solutions that support efficient workshop operations across the TRATON Group.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Develop and maintain **full-stack functionality within the Software Update domain**, using C#/.NET, AWS and Angular across frontend, backend, microservices and APIs;
* Build robust and user-friendly solutions that enable **safe and reliable software updates of vehicles**;
* Take part in the complete software lifecycle – from requirements, design and implementation to testing, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, support and maintenance;
* Collaborate closely with developers, testers, Product Owner and Scrum Master within the team, as well as with other teams across TWS;
* Troubleshoot complex technical issues across frontend, backend, cloud services and integrations;
* Continuously improve system stability, observability, maintainability, quality and user experience;
* Contribute to testing and validation in development environments, rigs and real vehicles;
* Contribute actively to the team's way of working, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

**Who You Are**
---------------

We believe you are a collaborative and curious full-stack software developer who enjoys solving real problems for end users and understanding the complete solution.

  

You have **at least 3 years of relevant professional experience** and a solid foundation in software development. You don't need to have worked with every technology in our stack – what matters is that you have relevant experience, enjoy learning and can contribute effectively as part of a team.

  

You have experience with **C#/.NET, cloud development such as AWS and microservice architectures**, combined with frontend development. **Experience with Angular is preferred**, while experience with other modern frontend frameworks, such as React, is also valuable.

  

You do not need to be equally strong in frontend and backend development, but you should be comfortable working across both and willing to contribute wherever the team needs you.

  

For us, technical competence is only part of what makes a great developer. **How you collaborate, communicate and contribute to the team is equally important.** We are looking for someone who enjoys working closely with others, shares knowledge, asks for help when needed and actively helps others succeed. We value shared ownership and believe that the best results are achieved together.

  

You are comfortable communicating with different audiences – from discussing technical details with fellow developers to explaining complex technical topics to stakeholders with different levels of technical knowledge. You can adapt your communication to your audience, making complex topics understandable without losing what is important. You listen to different perspectives and seek to understand the needs behind what we build.

  

You take initiative and ownership while staying aligned with the team. You are curious about the customer and want to understand not only **how** something should be built, but **why it matters to the people using it**.

  

Experience within automotive software, vehicle communication, distributed systems, DevOps, observability or similar technically complex environments is considered an advantage, but not a requirement. Most importantly, you are motivated to learn the domain, contribute to the team and grow together with us.

  

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and value different experiences and perspectives. **If you are excited about the role but don't meet every qualification listed, we still encourage you to apply.**

**This Is Us**
--------------

**Team Jaguar** is a cross-functional team of developers and testers responsible for the **Software Update domain within the TRATON Workshop Suite**.

  

Our solutions enable workshop technicians to perform software updates on vehicles, making our work both technically challenging and directly connected to the end-user experience. We develop across frontend, backend and cloud services and collaborate closely with other TWS teams whose capabilities together enable the complete workshop solution.

  

Jaguar is one of several teams that together develop the TRATON Workshop Suite. We have clear ownership of our domain while depending on and contributing to the wider TWS ecosystem. Close collaboration across team boundaries is therefore a natural part of how we work.

  

Within Jaguar, we work closely together and share responsibility for what we build and operate. **Different experiences, perspectives and strengths make the team better**, and we help each other solve problems, share knowledge and learn along the way. We want an environment where people feel comfortable asking questions, contributing ideas and challenging existing solutions constructively.

  

We strive to work in an **agile and iterative way**, with close collaboration, shared ownership and continuous improvement. As a team, we plan, build, evaluate, learn and adjust together, continuously looking for ways to improve both our solutions and how we work.

  

Joining Team Jaguar means becoming part of a collaborative team where you can work across the full technology stack, **broaden your skills across frontend, backend and cloud development**, and contribute to solutions with a clear impact on workshop operations.

  

As part of the wider **TRATON Workshop Suite development organization**, you will also be exposed to different technical domains, technologies and challenges, creating opportunities to broaden your experience and continue developing over time. You will have opportunities to learn from others, share your own expertise and grow together with the team as we continue developing the TRATON Workshop Suite.

**TRATON Offers**
-----------------

We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.

  

With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, TRATON Group R&D supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.

  

Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. We also arrange events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.

**Application**
---------------

We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.

  

Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-10-19. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check is required for this role.

If you have questions or would like more information, please contact: Mattias Gustafsson, Unit Head - System Development Service Products - TGROSDS, mattias.gustafsson@scania.com

  

**We look forward to your application!**

  

*This recruitment process is handled by Scania for TRATON Group**R&D.*

jobs.title: Engineer Principal.Product Development Engineering.V
jobs.description:
National Oilwell Varco Norway AS is seeking a Principal Product Responsible Engineer to join our Fluid Automation team and take ownership of the DORS Automation platform.
  
The role is responsible for driving the full product lifecycle—from concept and roadmap definition through development, release, and continuous improvement—while aligning the solution with NOV’s strategic objectives and customer needs.

You will lead the implementation of new features, ensure seamless integration with third-party automation tools, and help deliver high-quality process-control software to NOV’s global customers. Working closely with cross-functional teams, customers, and external partners, you will shape the product roadmap, support commercialization, and maintain the platform’s competitive position in the market.

  

* Lead the end‑to‑end development and release of the DORS Automation product
* Gather and translate customer and sales requirements into technical specifications
* Design, implement, and test new functionality using modern software technologies
* Integrate third‑party automation tools and ensure compatibility with existing systems
* Collaborate with cross‑functional teams including sales, engineering and after market
* Maintain product documentation, release notes, and technical manuals
* Provide technical support and troubleshooting for deployed solutions
* Drive continuous improvement and adopt best practices in software engineering
* Align product roadmap with NOV’s strategic objectives and market demands
* Mentor junior engineers and promote knowledge sharing within the team

  

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Mechatronics, Robotics, Automation Engineering, or related field
* 10+ years of experience in software development for industrial automation
* Proficiency in C++, C#
* Strong understanding of process control - PLC, SCADA, and HMI systems
* Experience integrating third‑party automation APIs and SDKs
* Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and software development methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum
* Proven track record of delivering complex software products on schedule
* Excellent communication skills for interfacing with customers and sales teams
* Ability to work in a multinational, matrix‑organized environment
* Knowledge of safety standards and regulations in oil & gas automation
* Fluent in English and Norwegian

**What we offer**

* **Meaningful product ownership** – take responsibility for the continued development and direction of DORS Automation, a solution actively used on drilling rigs.
* **Broad technical and business exposure** – work across software development, industrial automation, product strategy, sales, customers and aftermarket support.
* **Real operational impact** – develop automation that helps simplify drilling operations, improve efficiency and reduce the risk of manual errors.
* **Influence over future development** – identify improvements, new use cases and opportunities to expand DORS across additional rigs and applications.
* **Experienced technical environment** – collaborate with a team of software and automation engineers working across software, PLC and HMI technologies.
* **Structured onboarding** – NOV onboarding plus an approximately two-week departmental introduction covering products, PLC/HMI practices and software-development standards.
* **Some longer-term workplace flexibility** – the role is expected to begin primarily from the Oslo office; the Hiring Manager indicated that hybrid working can be considered once the person is established in the role and team.

jobs.description:

26WD101362

**Position Overview**

AutoCAD, the leading software for Computer-Aided Design, is seeking a highly motivated Software Engineer in Test intern to join our team to work on the test automation project for AutoCAD Toolset products.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to learn automation harness and test cases development with AI Tools, software automation process and agile process in software industry while guided by experienced automation developers. You will also learn about Autodesk flagship products: AutoCAD and Toolsets.

**On-site in-person recruitment drive starts from 9 October - 6 November 2026**

**Responsibilities**

  

* Understand different automation frameworks
* Understand different automation test cases
* Create different automation test cases with AI Tools
* Use Jenkins pipeline to test the test cases to make sure they are stable
* Document the technical details for future reference

**Minimum Qualifications**

  

* You must be enrolled in a full-time Bachelor's Program in Computer Science or Engineering or other relevant fields
* You must either be in your penultimate or final year of studies, and will be graduating in 2027 or 2028
* Understanding of object-oriented design, data structures and algorithms
* Experience of working with languages like C++/C#/Java/Python etc
* Self-motivated and eager to learn new technologies
* Internship period: 11 January - 25 June 2027 (fixed dates)

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Passion for developing robust software and writing maintainable code
* Keen interest in learning new tools and technologies
* Experience using AI Tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc)
* Flexibility under changing conditions and ability to multi-task between projects
* Fluent oral and written communication skills in English language
* Self-motivated with positive attitude

**Learning Benefits**

  

* Hands-on experience with test automation development with AI Tools
* Hands-on experience with test automation on Azure environment
* Learn best practices in writing and maintaining test automation
* Understand the role of test automation in software development process
* Exposure to industry leading flagship products in AutoCAD Family
